changes.issue: Writer could emit control characters rejected by the receiver.
changes.fix: Writer now enforces the same control-character rule before emitting a frame. Bounded decoder and persistent reader future retained.

changes.issue: Library transition should enforce writer permission independently of HTTP handler.
changes.fix: close_issue checks write permission; existing team predicate, transaction, and revision tests retained. Generated actual SQLx0.9 package metadata and verified online/offline optional query feature.

changes.issue: Finite execution did not bound durable admission.
changes.fix: Transaction-scoped advisory admission lock protects10,000-row cap, duplicate payload check and insertion; capacity test passed against PostgreSQL. Invalid system clock is returned explicitly.

changes.issue: Risk of overstating simulated durability and consensus.
changes.fix: Source and lesson explicitly label fixed-leader model, finite schedules, no elections/network/disk; prefix invariant and recovery tests retained.

changes.issue: Initial milestone lacked implemented persistent jobs/history/migration.
changes.fix: Added bounded durable replay jobs/cursors/cancellation, history1024/page256, version1 migration fixture and position-checked version2 writes; actual recovery/invalid-job/cursor tests.

changes.issue: Blocking task budget alone did not bound active handler/body wait.
changes.fix: Added16-request admission and5s deadline around router plus existing8 blocking-work slots; actual overload429 and slow-body408 tests. Timeout uncertainty explicitly taught.

changes.issue: Review language could frame weaker patterns as normal onboarding defaults.
changes.fix: Marked bad patterns as deliberate review defects; added project-specific Engineering decisions and evidence for all five projects; all lessons include concrete investigation/stuck panels.
Replaced all five with runnable, tested first checkpoints demonstrating bounds/errors/valid transitions and avoiding external infrastructure.

changes.issue: Pool/concurrent worker limits alone did not bound HTTP handlers.
changes.fix: Both APIs now admit16 active requests with5s handler/body deadline; scheduler pool has3s acquisition and statement timeouts. Timeouts retain uncertain-outcome semantics.

changes.issue: Later live requests could consume log slots reserved implicitly by accepted replay work.
changes.fix: Accepted replay work reserves remaining step capacity; boundary test consumes9997 live ticks then confirms replay still completes at event10000.

changes.issue: Author cross-review found public mutable Store.engine, lexical fill ordering, and ignored duplicate replay result.
changes.fix: Restricted engine to crate, added read-only Store.snapshot and compile-fail public-boundary test; bounded acceptance-order fill deque plus exact order lookup route; reject duplicate journal events and check physical-record cap. Regression tests use nonmonotonic IDs and duplicated legacy records.

changes.issue: Two parallel tests could choose the same timestamp-based temporary filename.
changes.fix: Added atomic ordinal to filename allocation; prior failure retained in services-test-first-failure.log. Full subsequent suite rerun.

changes.issue: Routine rejected orders and uncertain storage writes both used409, trapping the UI in unresolved state for normal invalid input.
changes.fix: Typed CommitError separates pre-append Rejected→422, identity Conflict→409, and Storage/any post-append inconsistency→503. Two API regressions cover quote/cash rejection with unchanged state, ID conflict, write failure, and poisoning. Nineteen native p16 tests plus compile-fail doc test passed; scoped Clippy executed.

changes.issue: Learner encoder omitted the reference protocol control-character rule.
changes.fix: Rejects all Unicode control characters before emission; newline and DEL rejection plus UTF-8 byte-length tests pass.

changes.issue: Middleware order and cookie/CSRF/TLS boundary reasoning needed focused practice and evidence.
changes.fix: Added substantial bridge lesson with runnable six-test boundary suite, deployment design assessment, prediction, deliberate error, worked review, and evidence limits.

limits: Public demo identities only; production auth/TLS excluded.
p16 single writer journal does not prove power-failure durability or multiple-process safety.
p15 is not Raft and does not provide production consensus.
No fabricated load/performance results; root verification reports actual measurements if executed.

findings.issue: Non-UTF-8 WORKBENCH_LOG silently selected the default path; malformed address environment could silently select a default, and journal I/O preceded address validation.
findings.change: Read the native journal path with var_os/PathBuf, distinguish an absent address from invalid text, validate loopback configuration before opening persistence, and escape the displayed path.
findings.verification: verification/workbench-config-check.json; current native build/Clippy; repeated actual HTTP acceptance audit.
findings.remaining_uncertainty: Native-byte path regression executed on Unix/macOS; Windows path behavior not separately exercised.
